evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks!D13 and its internal D13 annotation require the absence of [environment].docker_image while active agent build instructions remain. Python -B/tomllib parsing of frozen task/task.toml produced exactly build_timeout_sec, network_mode, cpus and memory_mb in [environment] (lines 20-24), with no docker_image key anywhere in that table. Active agent instructions are present at environment/Dockerfile:5-12 (apt/npm RUN), :14-15 (COPY instructions/assets), and :16-23 (workspace setup). This Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template, SHA256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1; task.toml SHA256 is cdaa31a87a3a5ec9539552049244c68b09aa5593903b6c32bde8269e2a893c40. In-memory negative controls adding either docker_image or the quoted key "docker_image" under [environment] were detected as overrides; the unchanged frozen template passed the same parsed-key predicate. The existing local/build-agent.log:21-33 explicitly lists the RUN/COPY build stages and :55-57 records successful image export. Its current SHA256 c7a2ad78e8ebdcce3ad570156674171dc0a38ca89b4a3976fcd5ac7894ab13cb matches the raw index. All 239 indexed artifact hashes matched; index SHA256 at review was 81d7e30b67ececf39d5d2351a9f41140a8e5e401174e6a80efe9b9d7503791f1. This is structural source evidence plus a direct local Docker build with cached dependency stages, not a hosted task-selection run, cold-build timing measurement, private checker execution or configured app grade. Full configured workload/grading, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target-model scores remain absent as explicitly stated by the index; none is inferred or waived by this row-specific Pass.
counterexample: Scope/control assessment: a broken blank or static app using this same unshadowed environment can pass row 12 because this row assesses task build selection, not application correctness. A structurally broken configuration setting docker_image="node:22-bookworm-slim" while retaining COPY assets/ and npm installation is rejected by the parsed check, including a quoted TOML-key spelling. A conforming alternative app implementation with the same unshadowed environment, or the frozen template configuration, is unaffected by app routes or UI choices and does not falsely fail this row. These are source/predicate controls, not app scoring runs.
